title: GTA 6 Prep: The San Andreas Mission You Need to Play First
description: Before GTA 6 arrives, IGN highlights the classic San Andreas mission 'Reuniting the Families'. Experience car chases, shootouts, and Terminator 2-inspired police action where Rockstar found its cinematic flair.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Classic San Andreas Mission to Play Before GTA 6

As the gaming community eagerly counts down the days toward the release of GTA 6, looking back at the roots of the franchise offers a fascinating perspective on how Rockstar Games evolved into an industry titan. Recently, media outlet IGN highlighted a standout mission from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas — 'Reuniting the Families' — noting it as the precise moment where Rockstar truly discovered its cinematic flair.

### Car Chases, Shootouts, and Pure Chaos

For veterans and newcomers alike, San Andreas remains a monumental entry in the open-world genre. The 'Reuniting the Families' mission encapsulates everything that makes the series legendary. It delivers an intense combination of chaotic car chases, high-stakes shootouts, and escalating danger where it truly feels like every character is fighting for their own survival.

### Recreating the Terminator 2 Vibe

One of the most memorable aspects of the mission is how the police recreate moments reminiscent of the cinematic classic Terminator 2. Rockstar's ability to weave cinematic action tropes into playable gameplay sequences set a new benchmark for the industry. This knack for blending Hollywood-style direction with open-world sandbox mechanics became a cornerstone of the studio's future projects, including the eventual development path leading up to GTA 6.

### Connecting the Past to GTA 6

While we await further official details regarding GTA 6, revisiting missions like this reminds us of Rockstar's long-standing dedication to cinematic storytelling. Analysis suggests that the studio's commitment to dramatic, tightly directed sequences will reach new heights with modern hardware in GTA 6. Playing through San Andreas right now is a great way to appreciate the foundation upon which the next evolution of the series is being built.

## Editor's Take

Revisiting 'Reuniting the Families' in San Andreas is a brilliant reminder of why Rockstar Games commands such immense loyalty. Long before the hype for GTA 6 took over the internet, these missions proved that video games could rival Hollywood blockbusters in sheer cinematic scope. It's a must-play experience for anyone looking to understand the DNA of modern open-world gaming.
